# HN Top 10
> Daily Korean translation and summary of Hacker News top 10 stories.

## About
HN Top 10 automatically translates and summarizes the top Hacker News stories into Korean every day for developers who want a concise view of global technology news.

## Features
- Daily top Hacker News stories
- Korean translation and summary
- Original article links preserved
- Date navigation for previous editions

## Language
- Korean, translated from English sources

## Category
Technology news, developer news, Hacker News curation

## Article URLs
Complete translations and verified summaries have permanent /article/{id} URLs with
server-rendered Korean text, original source links and publication/update times.
The internal article IDs are independent of Hacker News IDs. Other source categories
are supported by the publication layer, but only Hacker News is currently collected.
Daily archive URLs use /hn/?date=YYYY-MM-DD and retain their own canonical URLs.
